description_en: Queries the field information of a metatable
description_zh: 该接口用于获取表的字段信息
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public get-meta-table-column --table-guid odps.engine_name.table_name --page-num 1 --page-size 10 --cluster-id C-010A704DA7600000 --database-name abc --table-name abc --data-source-type emr --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetMetaTableColumn

parameters.description_en: The GUID of the metatable. You can call the [GetMetaDBTableList](~~2780086~~) operation to query the GUID.
